intro.h2: One tile specialist, from the first call to the cleanup
paragraphs: Tilesense L.L.C. is the tile contractor Vero Beach, FL homeowners call when a shower needs attention, a backsplash needs installing or grout and tile have seen better days. Bret is the name in every review. One customer says that from the first phone call through his diagnosis of the problem to the finished shower refresh, he was amazing.

Another couple hired him for a badly damaged outdoor tiled patio. They say he quoted a fair price with no pressure, communicated often, took time to explain everything and cleaned up beautifully. A kitchen customer calls him professional, knowledgeable and meticulous, and says he obviously loves what he does.

items.name: Shower refreshes and repairs
items.blurb: A shower that leaks, looks dull or just feels tired starts with a diagnosis. Bret works out what is actually wrong before he touches a tile, then refreshes or repairs the shower. One customer says he could not be more satisfied and called the quote very reasonable.

service_area.h2: Tile contractor in Vero Beach, FL
service_area.text: Tilesense L.L.C. serves homeowners in Vero Beach, Florida. If you live nearby and are not sure whether your home is in range, call (772) 501-3726 any day between 6 AM and 8 PM. Tell Bret where you are and what is going on with your shower, backsplash, grout, floor or patio, and he will tell you whether he can help.

items.q: My shower leaks or looks worn. Can you help?
items.a: Yes. Bret starts by diagnosing the problem, then repairs or refreshes the shower. One customer who had his shower refreshed says Bret was amazing from the first call to the finished job, that he is a true master of his trade and that the quote was very reasonable.

Yes. Backsplash installation is one of the services customers mention in our Google reviews. Vicki W. had Bret install a backsplash in her kitchen and says he did an amazing job. Call with the size of the wall and the tile you like, and we can talk about the layout.

items.q: Can you clean or fix my grout instead of replacing the tile?
items.a: Grout cleaning is the service mentioned most in our reviews, and tile repair and loose tile repair come up too. Sometimes the tile itself is fine and the grout or a few loose pieces are the real problem. Bret will look at it and tell you honestly what makes sense.

items.q: Do you work on outdoor patios?
items.a: Yes. One couple had a very damaged outdoor tiled patio, and they say Bret did a beautiful job, quoted a fair price with no pressure, explained everything and cleaned up beautifully afterward. Call us about your patio and we will set up a time to look at it.

Our Google hours are 6 AM to 8 PM, seven days a week, including Saturday and Sunday. Call (772) 501-3726, or email tilesense2@gmail.com with a few photos of the tile you want fixed, cleaned or installed, and Bret will be in touch.
